tenantId.description: Phase 1 tenant is derived by the server; clients cannot select it.

profileVersion.description: Server-owned profile aggregate version; equals stateVersion.

targetGoal.description: Compatibility-only profile shadow. It never selects a goal or contributes to planning input; use B9LearnerTarget.goalCode.

B9LearnerProfilePatch.description: 只提交可由学习者修改的字段；principalId、tenantId、role、owner、server versions 和权限事实由服务端派生。targetGoal 历史影子字段保留定义，但写入恒以 422 拒绝。

targetGoal.description: Compatibility-only profile shadow retained for historical reads. PATCH submissions are server-rejected with 422 and never become planning authority; use PUT /api/v1/learner/targets.

x-version-policy.equality: targetVersion MUST equal stateVersion in every response; stateVersion is retained as a compatibility alias

targetVersion.description: Server-owned learner target aggregate version; equals stateVersion.

B9LearnerTargetUpsert.description: 目标命令不接受 tenantId、owner/principal 或 server version 字段；目标始终绑定到已验证主体。

x-version-policy.equality: preferenceVersion MUST equal stateVersion in every response; stateVersion is retained as a compatibility alias

preferenceVersion.description: Server-owned learner preference aggregate version; equals stateVersion.

B9LearnerPreferencesPatch.description: UI locale、content locale、主题和无障碍设置分开持久化；contentLocale 不得覆盖 UI locale；server versions and identity are never accepted.

label.description: Localized display label for the enclosing B9GoalOptions.contentLocale.

B9PlanningInputSnapshot.description: Immutable, server-assembled planning facts. Eligibility is pinned only as a server-derived digest of adult gate, required consents, phase and policy; raw authority facts, placement raw answers, score, algorithm, SRS and mastery facts are never part of this snapshot.

B9FirstDayRecovery.description: Read-only subject-bound recovery projection. No retry, approve or close command is represented here.

projectionWatermark.description: Monotonic opaque learner projection watermark used to reject stale or mixed first-day reads.

x-consistency: state=NOT_READY implies taskCount=0 and blocker is present
state=PROCESSING implies taskCount=0 and planningInput/job are present
state=READY implies planningInput/plan are present and taskCount>=1
state=DEGRADED implies planningInput/degradedReason/recovery are present and state is never READY
job and recovery input pin fields MUST equal the embedded planningInput pin fields
plan input pin, digest, watermark, content epoch and projection version MUST equal the embedded planningInput fields

x-state-policy.notReady: empty tasks plus an explicit blocker; no planning, plan, failure or recovery fields
x-state-policy.processing: empty tasks plus immutable planningInput and job; no plan, failure or recovery fields
x-state-policy.ready: at least one task plus immutable planningInput and plan; no blocker, job, failure or recovery fields
x-state-policy.degraded: empty tasks plus immutable planningInput, safe reason and read-only recovery; never a READY result
